review:
No bonus rounds. No buy options. Just base-game spinning, made with Cream Team on an asymmetric ways layout, with a Golden Pineapple at the top of the paytable.

Win Slice gives every matching line a satisfying finish. Medium-high volatility, a 4,500x max and a 97.6% RTP – one of the highest anywhere. Perfect if you're tired of waiting for bonuses.
pros: Excellent 97.60% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
